scripts.build: pnpm run build:content && pnpm run build:background && pnpm run build:popup && pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:mac
scripts.build:chrome: rm -rf dist-chrome && mkdir -p dist-chrome/images && cp chromium/manifest.json dist-chrome/ && cp ../Extension/Resources/images/icon-*.png ../Extension/Resources/images/toolbar-icon-*.png dist-chrome/images/ && esbuild src/chromium/content.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --minify --inject:src/chromium/shim.ts --outfile=dist-chrome/content.js && esbuild src/chromium/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome120 --minify --inject:src/chromium/shim.ts --outfile=dist-chrome/background.js
